description: Fetch the people who commented on a single LinkedIn post (and their comment text), including replies to comments. Costs 1 credit per page of up to 100 comments, walking up to max_pages pages (default 10), so at most max_pages credits; cached pages are free. The output's fetched / total_available / truncated fields say when the post had more comments than were fetched. Each comment and reply is persisted to post_engagements with the commenter and full comment text.

max_pages.description: Max pages of up to 100 comments to fetch (1-20, default 10). Each page costs 1 credit.

refresh.description: Bypass the cache and re-fetch from LinkedIn (costs 1 credit per page). Default false: previously-fetched pages are returned free, with how long ago they were retrieved.

name: linkedin_post_comments
title: LinkedIn Post Comments
